1.he: יוצא דופן שאלתיאל לא יוצא ירך
1.note: Wordplay: 'yotse dofen' (born by Caesarean section) here means not a true descendant, as opposed to 'yotse yerekh,' issue of his loins (cf. Gen 46:26).

2.he: וכל שכן דפקר טפי להוליד ביתרון קושי
2.note: The phrase דפקר טפי is obscure. It is rendered tentatively as referring to a still younger or less fit begetter; the reading may be corrupt.

3.note: Refers to a girl discussed earlier (apparently in ch. 17) in connection with very early childbearing. The name is transliterated because the identification is uncertain.

4.note: Abraham ibn Daud, author of Sefer ha-Qabbalah.

5.note: Probably Benjamin ben Judah (of Rome), a commentator on Chronicles. The abbreviation הב"א is left untranslated.

6.note: Literally 'passed the sum.' Taken here as exceeding the minimal age assumed; the sense is not certain.
